headline: Varvee, JTL Defence, Fusion CX set record date Nov 27 for corporate actions
hook: Record date for share split, rights issue, dividend
summary: Varvee Global, JTL Defence and Fusion CX have announced November 27, 2026 as the record date for upcoming corporate actions. Varvee will execute a share split, JTL is preparing a rights issue worth up to ₹24.58 crore, and Fusion CX will pay a final dividend of ₹0.75 per share. The rights issue may dilute existing shareholders, while the share split could adjust the share price and improve liquidity. Investors holding shares in these companies should note the potential impact on their holdings.
why_it_matters: Potential share dilution and dividend income

headline: Varvee Global sets November 27 record date for stock split
hook: Varvee Global stock split record date nears

modes.bear: A stock split does not change company fundamentals or underlying value, despite recent price volatility.
modes.bull: Increased liquidity and lower share price may attract more retail participation following the split.
modes.simple: A stock split divides existing shares into more pieces, lowering the price per share but keeping your total investment value the same.

summary: Varvee Global has scheduled a stock split for November 27, reducing the face value of its shares from ₹5 to ₹2. The company's shares rose 1% to ₹54.37 on November 23 ahead of the event. Despite a 334% return over three years, the stock has declined 28% in the past year. Shareholders on record by the cutoff date will be eligible for the split.
whats_next: November 27 record date for stock split
why_it_matters: Share price will adjust proportionally on the ex-split date.

headline: Varvee Global approves equity share sub-division through a postal ballot
hook: Liquidity boost via stock split at Varvee
summary: Varvee Global has received approval to sub-divide its equity shares through a postal ballot process. A stock split increases the total number of shares while reducing the face value per share proportionally. This corporate action generally aims to improve liquidity and make the stock more affordable for retail participants. Shareholders of the company are directly affected by the adjustment in share count and price.
whats_next: Exchange filing on record date for the split
why_it_matters: More shares at a lower price per unit for holders
